card.name: Multiplier words before ratio numbers
card.fires_on: The word "factor"/"factors" or the following "of", and linking words after a fold or times figure, where a multiplication amount is about to be given. Seen in exposure increases, dose multiples and general growth comparisons.

modes.label: Increased by factors of
modes.description: The word factor(s) or the "of" after it, just before the multiplier value.
modes.example: with paroxetine (a strong inhibitor of CYP2D6) resulted in increases in the C max and AUC of tamsulosin by<< factors>> of 1.3 and 1

modes.label: After times or fold figures
modes.description: A comma, "and" or "times" in a list of multiples, such as 2.4- and 9-fold or times, respectively.
modes.example: the C max and AUC were increased 2.4-<< and>> 9-fold, respectively, in subjects

card.writes: It seems to push toward ratio and multiplier wording such as fold, percent and ratio.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a sentence where a "how many times higher" amount is being introduced.
